outcome: Delivery rate within 24 hours of insertion
Maternal pain perception during catheter insertion (VAS score)
cohort: 103 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies at ≥39 weeks of gestation undergoing labor induction with a double-balloon catheter for obstetric indications.
finding: Maternal BMI did not affect the success of labor induction with a cervical ripening double-balloon catheter, while parity and Bishop scores were significant influencing factors.
